description: Security & code quality: add declare(strict_types=1) to all auth controllers that currently lack it, extract payInvoice() inline validation to a FormRequest, add honeypot to the login form, and emit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on the four public legal/FAQ pages. Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: STRICT TYPES AUDIT: add 'declare(strict_types=1);' on line 2 (after the opening <?php tag, before the namespace line) in every Auth controller file that currently lacks it. Files to update: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/AuthenticatedSessionController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/RegisteredUserController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ConfirmablePasswordController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationNotificationController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/EmailVerificationPromptController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/PasswordController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/PasswordResetLinkController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/NewPasswordController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerifyEmailController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ExpiredPasswordController.php, app/Http/Controllers/Auth/ResendVerificationController.php. Also add to: app/Http/Controllers/WalletController.php, app/Http/Controllers/GoalController.php, app/Http/Controllers/SimulatorController.php, app/Http/Controllers/CalculatorController.php, app/Http/Controllers/PageController.php if missing. Read each file first (they may already have it in some) — only edit those that do not have 'declare(strict_types=1)' present.

PAYINVOICE FORMREQUEST: create app/Http/Requests/PayInvoiceRequest.php. The class extends Illuminate\Foundation\Http\FormRequest with declare(strict_types=1), namespace App\Http\Requests, and an authorize() that returns true (authorization is handled by the Policy called in WalletController). The rules() method returns exactly the validation array currently inline in WalletController::payInvoice(): source_wallet_id (required, uuid, exists in wallets table scoped to auth user, not same as the invoice wallet), amount (required, numeric, min:0.01, max:9999999999999), date (required, date, before_or_equal:today), ref (required, regex:/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/). The messages() method returns the custom messages array ('source_wallet_id.required', 'source_wallet_id.exists', 'date.before_or_equal'). Note: the source_wallet_id Rule::exists and Rule::notIn are dynamic (depend on the route model) — use the $this->route('id') value inside the rules() method. Then update app/Http/Controllers/WalletController.php::payInvoice() signature to accept PayInvoiceRequest $request instead of Illuminate\Http\Request $request, and remove the inline $request->validate() call, replacing it with $data = $request->validated().

HONEYPOT ON LOGIN: in resources/views/auth/login.blade.php, add '<x-ui.honeypot />' immediately after the '@csrf' line (same position as in register.blade.php). Then in app/Http/Requests/Auth/LoginRequest.php, add the honeypot validation rule to the rules() method. Import App\Rules\Honeypot. Add to the existing rules array: 'website' => ['nullable', new Honeypot('website')]. Read the existing LoginRequest first to find the right insertion point without disrupting the rateLimit or authenticate logic.

BREADCRUMB JSON-LD on public pages: (a) Add a new method to app/Interfaces/Services/StructuredDataServiceInterface.php: 'public function breadcrumbs(array $items): array;' where $items is an array of ['name' => string, 'url' => string] tuples. (b) Implement it in app/Services/StructuredDataService.php: build a BreadcrumbList schema.org array. The first item is always ['name' => 'Início', 'url' => route('home')]. Additional items come from $items. Format: ['@context' => 'https://schema.org', '@type' => 'BreadcrumbList', 'itemListElement' => [['@type' => 'ListItem', 'position' => 1, 'name' => 'Início', 'url' => route('home')], ...]]. (c) In resources/views/pages/privacy.blade.php, add at the top after the @section directives: @push('jsonld') <x-seo.json-ld :data="app(App\Interfaces\Services\StructuredDataServiceInterface::class)->breadcrumbs([['name' => 'Política de Privacidade', 'url' => route('privacy')]])" /> @endpush. Apply the same pattern to resources/views/pages/terms.blade.php (['name' => 'Termos de Uso', 'url' => route('terms')]), resources/views/pages/cookies.blade.php (['name' => 'Política de Cookies', 'url' => route('cookies')]), and resources/views/pages/faq.blade.php (['name' => 'Central de Ajuda', 'url' => route('faq')]). The x-seo.json-ld component (resources/views/components/seo/json-ld.blade.php) already exists and renders a <script type='application/ld+json'> tag.
acceptance_criteria: Every file listed in step 1 has 'declare(strict_types=1);' on line 2
app/Http/Requests/PayInvoiceRequest.php exists with declare(strict_types=1), correct namespace, all 4 validation rules, and custom messages
app/Services/StructuredDataService.php implements breadcrumbs() returning valid BreadcrumbList JSON-LD array
All 4 public pages (privacy, terms, cookies, faq) push a BreadcrumbList JSON-LD block via @push('jsonld')
composer test passes; composer lint passes; composer analyse passes
verification: composer test — all tests pass (AuthenticationTest, RegistrationTest, WalletAccessTest, PublicPagesTest all green)
composer analyse — PHPStan level 6 zero errors
findings: 1) declare(strict_types=1) added to 9 Auth controllers (AuthenticatedSessionController, RegisteredUserController, ConfirmablePasswordController, EmailVerificationNotificationController, EmailVerificationPromptController, PasswordController, PasswordResetLinkController, NewPasswordController, VerifyEmailController) + 5 other controllers (WalletController, GoalController, SimulatorController, CalculatorController, PageController). ExpiredPasswordController and ResendVerificationController already had it. 2) app/Http/Requests/PayInvoiceRequest.php created — subsequent FEATs can use this FormRequest for invoice payment validation. 3) WalletController::payInvoice() now accepts PayInvoiceRequest; Illuminate\Validation\Rule import removed from WalletController. 4) LoginRequest.php now has declare(strict_types=1) and the honeypot rule 'website' => ['nullable', new Honeypot('website')]. The 'nullable' modifier ensures the rule is skipped when the field is absent/null, so existing tests that do not send the website field continue to pass. 5) StructuredDataServiceInterface now has breadcrumbs(array $items): array — items use 'name'+'url' keys (not 'label'+'url' like breadcrumbList). The service prepends ['name' => 'Início', 'url' => route('home')] automatically. 6) composer analyse (full run) fails with a pre-existing PHPStan internal/environment error on CreditCardInvoiceService.php (phar stub path resolution bug). All changed files analysed individually with vendor/bin/phpstan show zero errors. composer test (1074 pass, 15 skip) and composer lint (0 violations) are both clean.
